title: Kept point-in-time rows in annual and quarterly histories
points: Explicit annual and quarterly requests now carry typed cadence and period-count fields from the Router into the financial-statements lane.
Annual history aligns 12-month flow rows with point-in-time balance-sheet rows at the same annual dates; quarterly history applies the same contract to 3-month flows.
Last-N mixed-statement requests select one shared date window before retrieving metrics, preventing balance-sheet or flow rows from silently dropping.
Reliability evals now assert exact period counts, required duration families, forbidden duration families, and the aligned D1 view used by the lane.

A repeatable anonymized cohort builder can sample 100 distinct queries from the most active non-owner users for production-shaped test-Worker evaluation without committing user identities or query content.
